info.title: Travelly NBP Admin Application Review and Private Documents
info.description: Frozen documentation contract; no implementation claim. Scope: 8 operations, existing 20 application tables. Read Final Decisions and 04-ADMIN-REVIEW-PREREQUISITES. Existing six Auth operations remain governed by Auth, not replaced here.

get.description: Exclude PASSENGER/ADMIN and reviewer-owned application rows before search, totals and pagination. Sort requested_at ASC,id ASC; has_next=page*page_size<total. Empty/out-of-range page is 200, never fake rows. No GET body.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Trim, reject control characters; literal case-insensitive substring on name/public reference only.

get.description: Owner/Driver targets only; absent or Passenger/Admin target 404 APPLICATION_NOT_FOUND, own Admin detail 403 REVIEW_FORBIDDEN. An unavailable document dependency is 503, not an empty successful evidence result. No query/body.

Scope authorization before count/page. Sort submitted_at DESC NULLS LAST,id ASC. Owners see own user/vehicle records; Admin verification may see others; own Admin files remain readable as owner without self-verification. No GET body.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: Mutually exclusive with vehicle_id; ownership restriction only.

get.x-authorization: Eligible authenticated resource owner or APPROVED Admin reviewer; per-request authorization

post.description: Exactly one multipart file, PDF/JPEG/PNG only, maximum 10 MiB. Existing owner_type/owner_id/document_type/number/date inputs map to existing columns; issuing_country maps existing documents.issuing_country (required LK for Driver licence review). Normal users upload only their own evidence, including pending applicants. Out-of-scope ownership is opaque 404 DOCUMENT_NOT_FOUND. No arbitrary URL/upload token/storage key. Successful validated/durable upload creates SUBMITTED with server-controlled actor/time/version; no role approval/contact verification.
post.x-authorization: Eligible authenticated resource owner or APPROVED Admin reviewer; per-request authorization

get.description: No query/body. secure_file_url is only the authenticated relative backend path. Opaque 404 for absent/out-of-scope documents. No storage key, provider URL or credential.
get.x-authorization: Eligible authenticated resource owner or APPROVED Admin reviewer; per-request authorization

get.description: No query/body, redirect, signed/public URL or Range variant. Current owner/Admin/session/account checks on every request. Stream verified bytes; optional UI blob URL remains local. Failure before headers is structured JSON; failure after headers aborts stream, never appends JSON to file data.

200.description: Authenticated binary stream, not a JSON response.

Content-Disposition.description: inline with sanitized server filename; no header injection.

get.x-authorization: Eligible authenticated resource owner or APPROVED Admin reviewer; per-request authorization

patch.description: PENDING -> APPROVED/REJECTED; APPROVED -> SUSPENDED only. Approval rechecks required APPROVED/unexpired evidence and ownership under lock. Reason required for reject/suspend, null/omitted for approve. Expected version required. No self-review or Passenger/Admin targets. Confirmed durable journal intent must precede normal PostgreSQL commit; no prepared transactions.

value.message: The record changed. Refresh and review again.

patch.x-commit-uncertainty: 503 promises no decision commit only before COMMIT is issued or after confirmed rollback. If COMMIT outcome is unknown, reconcile by journal xid8 before definitive response. If unresolved within the request, return safe 500 INTERNAL_ERROR stating the outcome could not be confirmed and to refresh before retrying, without a rollback/no-change assertion; client reloads detail. A committed retry with old version returns 409, not another mutation.

patch.description: SUBMITTED -> UNDER_REVIEW; UNDER_REVIEW -> APPROVED/REJECTED/NEEDS_CORRECTION. No self-verification. Negative/correction requires reason. NEEDS_CORRECTION does not change role PENDING; role rejection is separate. Version and confirmed durable audit intent required.

value.message: The record changed. Refresh and review again.

If COMMIT outcome is unknown, reconcile by journal xid8 before definitive response. If unresolved within the request, return safe 500 INTERNAL_ERROR stating the outcome could not be confirmed and to refresh before retrying, without a rollback/no-change assertion; client reloads detail. A committed retry with old version returns 409, not another mutation.

BearerAuth.description: Existing access JWT plus live infrastructure session/account/current role/ownership checks; JWT claims alone are insufficient.

RoleReviewRequest.description: Strict JSON types; trim reason before length validation. Omitted/null reason only for approval/start-review. Version is expected current version; no alias or actor/time fields.

DocumentReviewRequest.description: Strict JSON types; trim reason before length validation. Omitted/null reason only for approval/start-review. Version is expected current version; no alias or actor/time fields.

file.description: Exactly one PDF/JPEG/PNG, 1-10485760 bytes; actual content checked.

DocumentUploadRequest.description: Multipart scalar text values are parsed by the declared field type. Optional values must be omitted when absent; literal null strings and repeated/unknown fields are invalid. number maps to documents.document_number. Owner and reviewer/status/storage fields are never client authority.

x-timestamps: UTC RFC3339 with Z; explicit nulls. JSON strict types, no unknown/duplicate keys; multipart scalar parsing explicit.
